label: rem:ks-finiteness-via-diamond-lemma
title: Algebraic shortcut: Kontsevich--Soibelman's ind-constructibility from the Diamond Lemma
html: Remark (Finiteness via Diamond Lemma). Kontsevich-Soibelman must assume ind-constructibility to measure their 3CY moduli stacks. The QOU framework avoids this assumption completely. The Gröbner-Shirshov confluent normal forms guarantee a finite basis of standard monomials at every length. The length slices construct finite-dimensional schemes immediately. The topological structure extracts rigorous finiteness directly from the Diamond Lemma.
